news.author: Garrett Ball
news.title: Mansoor Delane (shoulder) out for remainder of Monday night
news.desc: Mansoor Delane (shoulder) has been ruled out for the rest of the Chiefs game against Denver on Monday night.
news.impact: Delane had a pick against Bo Nix early, but got knocked out of the game shortly after. He will now focus on trying to get back onto the field for the Chiefs Week 2 contest.

news.author: Chris Schommer
news.title: Patrick Mahomes II (knee) active for Week 1
news.desc: Patrick Mahomes II (knee) is active for Week 1 for the Kansas City Chiefs against the Denver Broncos.
news.impact: Mahomes II cleared through every obstacle in his way in recovering from a late-season knee injury in 2025-26, as the dynamic signal-caller looks to lead a revamped Kansas City offense back to the postseason beginning with the Week 1 divisional matchup against a disruptive Denver defense Monday night.

news.author: Chris Schommer
news.title: Xavier Worthy (shoulder) active for Week 1
news.desc: Xavier Worthy (shoulder) is active for Week 1 for the Kansas City Chiefs against the Denver Broncos.
news.impact: Worthy will suit up after being able to practice throughout the week for head coach Andy Reid, joining fellow wideout Rashee Rice (knee) in offering quarterback Patrick Mahomes a full complement of weapons against a strong Denver defense Monday night.

news.author: Chris Schommer
news.title: Rashee Rice (knee) active for Week 1
news.desc: Rashee Rice (knee) is active for Week 1 for the Kansas City Chiefs against the Denver Broncos.
news.impact: Rice will suit up after progressing throughout the practice week and not suffering any issues in pregame activities, providing quarterback Patrick Mahomes with all of his pass-catching weapons against the Broncos Monday night.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Sam Darnold dealing with 'unique' soft-tissue injury
news.desc: The Seahawks say Sam Darnold has a "very unique" soft-tissue injury.
news.impact: Darnold's hip joint is unaffected. It is considered a short-term injury, meaning likely less than four weeks with him avoiding injured reserve.
